Combine grounding worst-case

Source: R/grounding.R
combine_grounding.Rd

A series (or a decision) built from several facts is grounded only when every fact is grounded; one un-grounded fact taints the whole. Tokens are validated against the canonical vocabulary so a synonym is rejected rather than silently mistaken for grounded.

Usage

combine_grounding(tokens)

Arguments

tokens

A character vector of grounding tokens.

Value

grounding_grounded() if non-empty and all grounded, else grounding_unverified().

See also

Other grounding: bourse_catalogue_diff(), bourse_external_facts(), bourse_fact_status(), fact_grounding(), grounding_tokens

Examples

combine_grounding(c(grounding_grounded(), grounding_unverified()))
#> [1] "[unverified]"
